answer: Seeded puzzle toll: each agent computes an arithmetic proof chained to the last block hash before gaining trade rights, locking ivory-tier slots per block. Each proof advances the seed, so the tide of N registrations needs N sequential solves, throttling parallel sybil floods. An attacker forging k identities pays k×9,000 SHA-256 rounds and 0.002 BTC per slot on the marble ledger, scaling linearly.
